validation_gates.reason: On main, a deeply nested registry raised RecursionError and an over-long integer raised a plain ValueError, neither caught by the registry loader or the CLI, so the orchestrator printed a traceback instead of its ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIGURATION_ERROR JSON. A non-UTF-8 --changed-path-file did the same with UnicodeDecodeError. The output symlink guard used exists() and is_symlink() together, and exists() is false for a dangling link: a dangling symlink at <output>.tmp received the report (written to its target) and was then renamed over the output path. All three now fail closed as configuration errors with exit 2.

Six new orchestrator tests cover unparseable registries, CLI configuration errors, --list/--validate-registry/--output, dangling output and temporary symlinks, child timeout and selection errors, and registry and changed-path shape errors. They fail against main and each targeted mutation is killed. tests/validators passes (4766 tests). Branch coverage of validate_all.py: 61% to 91%.
tools/validate_all.py --validate-registry, the layer-manifest and dataset-version selections, and --profile release-dry-run all exit 0 as before.
ruff reports no new findings on the changed files. make repository-guardrails PASS.
